grammar.title: Subject Pronouns
grammar.explanation:
Ega olmoshlari shaxs yoki narsa nomi oʻrniga keladi va gapda ega boʻladi.

- **I** — men
- **You** — sen / siz
- **He** — u (erkak)
- **She** — u (ayol)
- **It** — u / bu (narsa yoki hayvon)
- **We** — biz
- **They** — ular

Inglizchada ega shart — olmosh (yoki ism)siz gap toʻgʻri boʻlmaydi. Oʻzbek tilida esa ega koʻpincha tushiriladi («Ishlayman»), inglizchada tushirib boʻlmaydi: **I** work.

rules.pattern: I / You / He / She / It / We / They + fe’l
He = erkak, She = ayol, It = narsa/hayvon
rules.note: Odam uchun He/She, narsa uchun It.
We gapiruvchini oʻz ichiga oladi, They esa yoʻq.

exercises.prompt: Ali is a boy. ___ is my friend.
Sara is a girl. ___ is happy.
This is a cat. ___ is small.
exercises.promptTranslated: Narsa yoki hayvon uchun qaysi olmosh?

exercises.prompt: My brother and I are here. ___ are students.
The woman is here. ___ is my teacher.

grammar.title: Verb To Be (am / is / are)
grammar.explanation:
Oʻzbek tilida «Men talabaman», «Sen talabasan», «U talaba» deymiz — kesim qoʻshimchasi (-man, -san) soʻzga ulanadi. Inglizchada esa buning oʻrniga alohida **to be** fe’li keladi. U egaga qarab uch shaklga ega:

- **I** (men) → **am**
- **He / She / It** (u) → **is**
- **You / We / They** (sen, siz, biz, ular) → **are**

**He, She, It nima bilan farq qiladi?** Oʻzbek tilida hammasi «u», inglizcha esa ajratadi:

- **He** = u — **erkak** uchun (a man, a boy, ota, aka). Misol: my father → **he**.
- **She** = u — **ayol** uchun (a woman, a girl, ona, opa). Misol: my mother → **she**.
- **It** = u/bu — **narsa va hayvon** uchun (a table, a dog, mushuk, kitob). Misol: my cat → **it**.

Uchalasi — **He**, **She**, **It** — **is** bilan keladi.

Inglizchada to be shart: «**I am** Ali» deymiz, «I Ali» emas.

Inkor **not** bilan: **am not**, **is not** (**isn't**), **are not** (**aren't**).

rules.note: He = erkak, She = ayol, It = narsa yoki hayvon. Uchalasi is bilan: He is, She is, It is.
Koʻplik va you uchun doim are.

rules.pattern: Inkor: is not = isn’t, are not = aren’t

exercises.explanation: Toʻgʻri tartib: I + am + a + teacher.

grammar.title: Introducing Yourself
grammar.explanation:
Oʻzingizni tanishtirishning ikki asosiy yoʻli bor:
1. **My name is …** — Mening ismim …
2. **I am …** — Men …man

Namuna: **Hello, I am Ali. My name is Ali.**

exercises.explanation: Toʻgʻri tartib: My + name + is + Ali.

grammar.title: Asking Names
grammar.explanation:
Boshqa odamning ismini soʻrash uchun:
**What is your name?** — Ismingiz nima?
Javob: **My name is …** yoki **I am …**

rules.pattern: Javob: My name is … / I am …

exercises.explanation: Toʻgʻri tartib: What + is + your + name.

comps.title: Greetings Builder
comps.passage: Hello! My name is Ali. I am a student. This is my friend. His name is Karim. He is a teacher. Good morning, Karim!
comps.passageTranslated: Salom! Mening ismim Ali. Men talabaman. Bu mening doʻstim. Uning ismi Karim. U oʻqituvchi. Xayrli tong, Karim!

comps.title: Listening: Meeting People
comps.passage: Hello! My name is Anna. I am a teacher. Good morning, everyone. This is my friend Tom. He is a student. Nice to meet you. Goodbye and see you soon!
comps.passageTranslated: Salom! Mening ismim Anna. Men oʻqituvchiman. Hammaga xayrli tong. Bu mening doʻstim Tom. U talaba. Tanishganimdan xursandman. Xayr va yana koʻrishguncha!

questions.question: Who is Tom?
questions.explanation: Matn: This is my friend Tom.

comps.title: Greetings and Introductions
comps.passage: Let's review greetings! Good morning! My name is Ali. I am a student. This is my friend Karim. He is a teacher. Thank you and goodbye!
comps.passageTranslated: Keling, salomlashishlarni takrorlaymiz! Xayrli tong! Mening ismim Ali. Men talabaman. Bu mening doʻstim Karim. U oʻqituvchi. Rahmat va xayr!

questions.question: What does Ali say at the end?

comps.title: Ali and His Friend
comps.passage: Hello! My name is Ali. I am a boy. This is my friend Sara. She is a girl. Sara is my friend. Good morning, teacher!
comps.passageTranslated: Salom! Mening ismim Ali. Men oʻgʻil bolaman. Bu mening doʻstim Sara. U qiz bola. Sara mening doʻstim. Xayrli tong, oʻqituvchi!

questions.question: Is Sara a boy or a girl?
questions.questionTranslated: Sara oʻgʻil bolami yoki qiz bola?

questions.question: Who is Sara?
questions.explanation: Matn: Sara is my friend. (friend/boy/man — hammasi 1-modulda oʻrgatilgan)

questions.question: How do you say 'Salom' in English?
Sara is a girl. ___ is happy.
